notes: §1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR3: a separately compiled program's name 'may be referenced by statements included in any other program in the run unit, except programs it directly or indirectly contains'. ProgramTable#ResolveVisible resolves an outermost name from any caller (rule 4, with ProbeSiblingModule loading a separately compiled module), which is the 2023 reach; the 1985 exclusion holds because a contained program can execute only while its outermost container is active (85 has no RECURSIVE attribute and no program-pointer), and Activate refuses an active non-recursive program, so the excluded CALL is 'cannot be made available' and takes ON EXCEPTION, while CancelNode refuses to cancel the active container (an undefined violation under §1985:I.1.6). Probes at --std 85: with SUBP compiled to its own module, a doubly contained DEEPN's CALL of SUBP by identifier took ON EXCEPTION on every call, including after CANCEL; MAINP and a program of MAINP's module reached SUBP across modules (counts 1, 2, then 1 after CANCEL); a contained program's CALL of its main program took ON EXCEPTION with main's data intact. The witness shows SUBIN refused and a program nested in another outermost program reaching SUBP.

next.reason: X3.23a-1989 (its change for page X-6, a typographical correction, errata C146) only boxed the exception as level 2; the words are the printed ones. §1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR3: a separately compiled program's name 'may be referenced by statements included in any other program in the run unit, except programs it directly or indirectly contains'. §2023:8.4.6.3 SR3: 'If the program-name is that of an outermost program, that program-name may be referenced by statements included in any source element in the run unit.' Same subject (who may reference an outermost program's name in CALL and CANCEL), different requirement: 2023 drops the words 'any other program' and 'except programs it directly or indirectly contains', so the program itself and the programs it contains may now reference its name, which 1985 refuses; the level-2 box is no difference. What 2023 does with such a call of an active program is a run-time matter outside this rule (§2023:14.9.4.4 GR3f: EC-PROGRAM-RECURSIVE-CALL unless the program has the recursive attribute).
